faq_what_a: A one-minute crypto price prediction game that runs as a Mini App inside Telegram. You predict whether the price closes above or below the round's start price.
faq_round_a: Each round has a start price. You choose your stake and tap PRICE UP or PRICE DOWN during the 15-second decision window. When the 45-second round ends, UP wins if the price closed above the start, DOWN wins if it closed below.
faq_length_a: 45 seconds, after a 15-second decision window — about one minute per cycle.
faq_assets_a: Currently SOL/USDC. Available markets are always shown in the app.
faq_start_a: Tap “Play on Telegram”. PriceOn opens inside Telegram — choose Demo and make your first prediction.
faq_telegram_a: Yes. PriceOn runs only as a Telegram Mini App — no separate download or account.
faq_demo_a: Practice mode with virtual Demo SOL. It can't be deposited, withdrawn or converted to real SOL, and you can reset it to 10.00 at any time.
faq_live_a: Live mode uses the SOL balance in your in-app wallet on Solana Mainnet. Trades are final once a round closes and you can lose your stake.
faq_fees_a: Yes — a flat 1% of your stake per prediction. It's shown before you confirm.
faq_referral_a: Share your personal code from the Profile tab. Invites, your monthly estimate and total paid are tracked there. Rewards are paid on a monthly cycle under the terms shown in the app.
faq_advice_a: No. PriceOn is a prediction game. Nothing here is investment or financial advice.
faq_risk_a: In Live mode you stake real SOL and can lose it. Short-term price moves are unpredictable. Start in Demo and only stake what you can afford to lose.
final_h2: Ready to make your first prediction?
risk_p1: PriceOn involves predicting short-term crypto price moves. In Live mode you stake real SOL and can lose it. Past results don't predict future results. Nothing on this site is financial advice.
risk_p2: Start in Demo, only stake what you can afford to lose, take breaks, and make sure using crypto products is allowed where you live.
legal: PriceOn is a crypto price prediction game. Demo mode uses virtual Demo SOL. Live mode uses real SOL on Solana Mainnet and you can lose your stake. Not financial advice.
dep_h2: Where to add SOL for Live mode
dep_sub: Demo needs no deposit. When you're ready for Live, funding happens inside the app — in three taps.
dep_1_p: Use the Live / Demo toggle at the top of the app.
dep_2_p: The yellow Deposit button appears in the header in Live mode.
dep_3_p: Add SOL to your in-app wallet. Your balance shows as Available SOL in Stats.
dep_note: Only deposit what you can afford to lose. Trades are final once a round closes.

ref_sub: Every PriceOn account has its own referral code. Here's exactly how it works.
ref_s1_p: Open Profile → Live referral. Your personal code is shown with copy and share buttons.
ref_s2_p: Send your code or link to friends and crypto groups in one tap.
ref_s3_p: Friends who join with your code are counted under “invited”. Rewards come from their Live activity.
ref_s4_p: Each month your rewards move from estimate → closed / reviewing → paid.

faq_refpay_a: Monthly. During the month you see an estimate; after the cycle closes it is reviewed, then paid out. Totals are always visible in Profile.
faq_refdemo_q: Does Demo play count for referrals?
faq_refdemo_a: No. Referral rewards come from invited players' Live activity. Demo uses virtual SOL only.
faq_depwhere_a: In the app: switch to Live, then tap the yellow Deposit button in the header. Demo never needs a deposit.
